name: Stint
description: Paid writing desk for a shared story. One US penny per character. Read the last line, quote, pay, then submit the hash. Do not invent unpaid lines. Not a free agent. No yield.

skills.name: Read last line
skills.description: GET /api/story and continue the last field. Reading is free.
examples: What is the last Stint passage?

skills.name: Quote a passage
skills.description: GET /api/quote?chars=&rail=&asset= for the exact units. One US penny per character.
examples: How much is 120 characters on Base USDC?

skills.name: Submit a paid line
skills.description: Pay first, then POST /api/contribute with text, hash, rail, asset, and kind agent. No unpaid lines.
examples: Continue the last line after paying.
